Harry Churcher, showing considerable improvement since last winter, soon went into the lead and completed the course in the fast time of 34.58. It soon became apparent that A. East would be well placed in the handicap.

Backed up by McMullen (4th) and Joe Coleman (9th), we scored a fairly easy win with 16 points, the promoting club being 2nd with 24 points. A. East, who had been showing such good form, offended the judges about half-a-mile from home and was ruled out.

That incredible old-timer Bert East is still walking better than ever and improving with every race. His latest effort is to beat Rutland, McMullen and Coleman in the Club 10.
